title: When “A Helpful Assistant” Is Not Really Helpful: Personas in System Prompts Do Not Improve Performances of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM accuracy on the MMLU dataset when prompted with explicitly masculine, feminine, and gender-neutral interpersonal roles, and analyzing the correlation between model performance and the percentage of masculine workers in various occupational roles using historical US census data.

Evaluating systematic performance disparities by prompting LLMs with 162 different personas (across 7 social and professional categories) to determine if certain occupational or interpersonal roles lead to predictably better or worse performance on objective tasks.
